title: Bombardier R142 for MTR 4.0
description: A Resource pack for the Minecraft Transit Railway Mod that allows you to set rolling stock of R142 Subway cars as seen on the New York City Subway.
body:
A Resource pack for the Minecraft Transit Railway Mod that allows you to set rolling stock of R142 Subway cars as seen on the New York City Subway.

Minecraft Transit Railway Mod 4.0 is required for this to work, you can download it here: https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-transit-railway

Notes: 
- Audio was sourced from OpenBVE.
- Provided is a .tif file to edit the strip map and access the image layers. If the .tif file is inaccessible or opens as a flat image, there's a folder containing the image layers as PNGs.
